text.bs: Torta pistacija & malina je bila hit proslave. Svi su pitali odakle je!
text.en: The pistachio & raspberry cake was the star of the party. Everyone asked where it was from!

text.bs: Dvospratna torta s mašnom izgledala je još ljepše nego na slici. Hvala na strpljenju oko svih detalja.
text.en: The two-tier bow cake looked even better than in the photo. Thank you for your patience with every detail.

text.bs: Naručio sam iz Njemačke za mamin rođendan u Mostaru. Sve dogovoreno preko WhatsAppa za pet minuta.
text.en: I ordered from Germany for my mum's birthday in Mostar. Everything was sorted over WhatsApp in five minutes.

text.bs: Torta "Mjesec i oblaci" je bila prava bajka, a pistacija čaše su nestale za deset minuta.
text.en: The "Moon & Clouds" cake was a fairytale, and the pistachio cups were gone in ten minutes.

text.bs: Breskvice kao kod nane, samo još ljepše složene. Naručujem svake godine.
text.en: Breskvice just like grandma's, only even prettier. I order them every year.
